headline: Garner Residence / Davey McEathron Architecture
context: Eclectic 1970s-inspired home designed by Davey McEathron Architecture with interiors + construction by Cary Paul Studios. This home in the heart of South Austin blends mid-century modern charm with 70s and Memphis modern-influenced interiors.
